svg.title: Ontos · Five-layer Ontology architecture
svg.desc: Landscape exploded axonometric view of the Ontos architecture from PostgreSQL 17 storage through Governance, the focal Kinetic Layer, the Semantic Graph, and the OSDK v2, Ontology MCP, and CLI Service Surfaces.

g.text: Caller-scoped row, property, and action policies
Transactional writes, rules, and isolated workers
Versioned domain model, search, and aggregations
Typed OSDK v2, Ontology MCP for AI agents, and CLI
